"""Pytest bootstrap for the standalone wiki project.

<file_change path="tests/test_server.py" language="python" change_type="new" encoding="text">
"""Behaviour tests for the standalone wiki site server (``server.py``).

These cover the observable contract of the documentation server: question
tokenisation, page resolution/path-traversal protection, manifest exposure and
the HTTP handler responses. No network, no clock, no shared mutable state.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

import server


@pytest.fixture()
def wiki(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Point the server at an isolated wiki root with one valid page."""
    root = tmp_path / "wiki"
    root.mkdir()
    (root / "guide.md").write_text(
        "---\ntitle: Guide Title\ndescription: How to build\n---\n\n# Heading\n\nBody text\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    (root / "docs.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"project": {"title": "Demo"}, "pages": [{"path": "guide"}]}),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "WIKI_ROOT", root)
    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "MANIFEST", root / "docs.json")
    monkeypatch.setattr(server, "WIKI_DIST", root / ".vitepress" / "dist")
    return root


def test_tokens_lowercases_and_drops_stopwords():
    assert server._tokens("How do I configure the Docker build?") == [
        "configure",
        "docker",
        "build",
    ]


def test_tokens_keeps_path_like_identifiers():
    assert server._tokens("api/codx/junior/efforts") == ["api/codx/junior/efforts"]


def test_page_path_adds_markdown_suffix_and_resolves_existing_page(wiki):
    resolved = server._page_path("guide")

    assert resolved is not None
    assert resolved == (wiki / "guide.md").resolve()


def test_page_path_rejects_traversal_outside_wiki_root(wiki):
    (wiki.parent / "secret.md").write_text("# secret\n", encoding="utf-8")

    assert server._page_path("../secret") is None


def test_page_path_returns_none_for_unknown_page(wiki):
    assert server._page_path("does-not-exist") is None


def test_page_returns_frontmatter_title_and_body_without_frontmatter(wiki):
    page = server._page("guide")

    assert page is not None
    assert page["path"] == "guide"
    assert page["title"] == "Guide Title"
    assert page["description"] == "How to build"
    assert page["content"].strip().startswith("# Heading")
    assert "title: Guide Title" not in page["content"]


def test_site_omits_pages_but_keeps_manifest_metadata(wiki):
    site = server._site()

    assert site["project"]["title"] == "Demo"
    assert "pages" not in site


def test_health_reports_ok_and_wiki_root(wiki):
    payload = server.health()

    assert payload["ok"] is True
    assert payload["wiki"] == str(wiki)
    assert payload["dist"] is False


def test_page_handler_raises_404_for_unknown_page(wiki):
    with pytest.raises(server.HTTPException) as excinfo:
        server.page(path="missing")

    assert excinfo.value.status_code == 404


def test_page_handler_returns_content_for_existing_page(wiki):
    payload = server.page(path="guide")

    assert payload["title"] == "Guide Title"


def test_static_site_route_never_shadows_api_prefix(wiki):
    with pytest.raises(server.HTTPException) as excinfo:
        asyncio.run(server.static_site("api/health"))

    assert excinfo.value.status_code == 404


def test_static_site_route_raises_404_when_no_build_output(wiki):
    with pytest.raises(server.HTTPException) as excinfo:
        asyncio.run(server.static_site("guide"))

    assert excinfo.value.status_code == 404
</file_change>
